app_tagline: E-books to audiobooks with neural voices · EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, TXT → M4B, MP3
cli_description: Convert e-books into audiobooks in the terminal.
cli_files_help: e-books to convert (EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, TXT)
cli_output_help: folder where the audiobooks are saved
cli_lang_help: interface language ({langs}); with no value, opens the list and saves your choice; default: the system language
opening_file_picker: Opening the file picker... (it may open behind this window)
no_file_chosen: No file chosen in the picker.
type_or_drag: Type or drag the files here (one or more per line). An empty line finishes.
opening_folder_picker: Opening the folder picker... (it may open behind this window)
ffmpeg_linux_hint: (or dnf / pacman, depending on your distribution)
sample_failed: Could not generate the sample ({error}). Check your internet connection.
year_invalid: Use 4 digits, like 2024 (or leave it blank).
language_invalid: Language not recognized. Type the name (e.g. French, Greek) or the code (e.g. fr, el).
language_unknown_choose: The book's language was not recognized. Choose the narration language:
no_voices: There are no voices for {language}. Choose another narration language.
listen_usage: Use o + the voice number, for example: o {n}
reusing_choices: Using the same choices as the other books in {language}: {translation}, {sync}, voice {voice}
ask_sync: Create synced text for audiobook players?
reuse_choices_q: Use these choices for the other {n} book(s) in {language} too?
fmt_m4b_desc: one file with chapters and cover — the standard for audiobook apps
fmt_mp3_desc: one file with chapters and cover, plays on any device
fmt_multi_desc: one track per chapter, in a folder
fmt_opus_desc: the smallest file for the same quality
fmt_wav_desc: uncompressed, for editing (tags, cover and chapters only in some programs; text stays outside the audio)
ctrl_c_hint: Ctrl+C to cancel. If it stops midway, convert again: everything already narrated is reused.
cancel_q: Cancel the conversion? Everything already narrated is kept so you can resume later.
ended_early: The conversion process ended before finishing this book.
unsupported_format: Unsupported format: {name} (use EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3 or TXT)
none_readable: None of the files could be read.
err_unreadable: Could not read the text of this file (it may be protected or contain only images).
err_write: Could not write to the output folder ({0}). Check that it exists (an external drive may have been disconnected) or choose another one.
err_space: Not enough space in the output folder: about {0} GB is needed and {1} GB is free.
err_busy: This book is already being converted in another window. Wait for that conversion to finish (or cancel it) before converting again.
ffmpeg_missing_mp3: FFmpeg not found: only MP3 is available (without chapter volume levelling).
ffmpeg_install_for_more: Install it for M4B, Opus, FLAC and WAV:  {command}
cli_voice_help: voice to use (e.g. en-US-AndrewNeural); skips the voice question
cli_format_help: output format; skips the format question
cli_quality_help: audio quality: voice (default, the size of the source voice), standard, high or max
cli_translate_help: translate the books to this language
cli_sync_help: create synced text for audiobook players
cli_yes_help: no questions: use the options given and the last choices (or the defaults)
voice_unknown: Unknown voice: {voice}. See the voice list without --voice.
err_translation_limit: Google's translation service refused the requests for excessive use. Wait a few minutes and convert again (what was already translated is kept), or convert without translating.
err_translation: Translation failed ({0}). Check your internet connection and convert again, or convert without translating.
err_tts: The voice service did not respond after several attempts ({0}). Check your internet connection and convert again: everything already narrated is kept and the conversion resumes where it stopped.
err_epub_corrupt: This EPUB is corrupted or incomplete (not a valid ZIP file).
err_epub_drm: This EPUB has DRM protection and can't be read. Use a copy without protection.
err_pdf_open: Could not open this PDF ({0}). The file may be corrupted.
err_pdf_password: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the protection before converting.
err_pdf_scanned: This PDF has no selectable text (it looks scanned, images only). Use a version with text or run the PDF through an OCR program first.
queued_lite: Queued (lite mode: one book at a time)
update_done: Updated to {version}. Open Audiobook Generator again to use it.
update_windows_window: The update continues in a new window. When it finishes, open Audiobook Generator again.
update_failed: The update didn't work. Update manually:
cli_no_update_help: don't check for a new version when starting
files_hint_picker: Press Enter (or o) to open the file picker again, or type/drag the files here (one or more per line; an empty line finishes).
no_folder_picked: No folder chosen in the picker.
folder_hint_picker: o opens the folder picker again, Enter uses the default folder, or type/drag a folder.
cli_lite_help: lite mode: one book at a time and fewer resources (remembered for next time)
cli_no_lite_help: never use lite mode, even on a lighter computer (remembered for next time)
lite_on_auto: Lite mode is on: this computer is lighter ({cores} cores, {ram} GB of memory{battery}).
lite_on_chosen: Lite mode is on (you chose it with --lite).
lite_what_changes: What changes compared with the adaptive mode:
lite_change_books: One book at a time: the others wait in line
lite_change_voice: 4 voice connections, instead of adjusting between 3 and 32
lite_change_cpu: One audio step at a time and the lowest CPU priority: the conversion only uses what's left over
lite_change_result: Same audio quality; the conversion is slower, but the computer stays free
lite_how_off: To use the adaptive mode instead: --no-lite (remembered for next time)
sync_detail_q: What should the synced text keep?
sync_both_desc: highlights the sentence and each word (recommended)
sync_sentences_desc: a lighter text, highlights sentence by sentence
sync_where_q: Where should the synced text be saved?
where_both: In the audiobook and in a separate file
where_both_desc: inside the audio file, plus .lrc, .srt and .sync.json files
where_metadata_desc: inside the audio file, with no extra files
where_file_desc: .lrc, .srt and .sync.json files next to the audio
sync_file_only: {format} has no place for text inside the file: the synced text is saved as a separate file.
cli_sync_detail_help: what the synced text keeps: both (default), sentences or words
cli_sync_save_help: where to save the synced text: both (default), metadata or file (formats without text in their metadata always use a file)
meta_missing: Could not be saved in the file: {items}
wav_limits: WAV: tags only show in some programs (Windows Explorer doesn't show them), and cover and chapters only in some players. Synced text is saved in a separate file.
language_hint: Interface language: {language}. To change it, close the file picker and type {key}.
files_hint_language: Type {key} to change the interface language.
err_disk_full: The disk ran out of space during the conversion. Free up some space or choose another folder, then try again.
err_file_in_use: A file from this conversion is open in another program (maybe a player). Close that program and try again.
err_permission: No permission to write to the destination folder. Choose another folder and try again.
err_memory: There wasn't enough memory to convert this book. Close other programs and try again: what was already narrated is kept.
err_network: The internet connection failed. Check your internet and try again: what was already narrated is kept.
err_ffmpeg: FFmpeg couldn't assemble the audio ({0}). Try again or choose another format.
err_ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg isn't installed, and this format needs it. Install FFmpeg or choose MP3.
err_missing_lib: The Python library "{0}" is missing. Install it with: python -m pip install {0}
sync_failed: The audiobook is ready, but the synced text failed: {0}
failed_what_now: What do you want to do?
retry_desc: what was already narrated is kept
skip_translation_desc: narrates in the book's language, with a voice of that language
cancel_desc: stop here; you can convert again later and keep what was narrated
foreground_hint: With this window in front, the conversion gets priority and goes faster. Minimized or behind other windows, it uses a bit less so you can keep using the computer.
